name.title: Name
name.description: You shouldn't need to change this.

hideTemperatureSensor.title: Hide Fan Temperature Sensor
hideTemperatureSensor.description: Enable this option to hide the temperature sensor.

temperatureOffset.title: Fan Temperature Offset
temperatureOffset.description: Subtract (or add) a set amount from the temperature reading (use negative numbers to subtract). This setting only applies to fans.

hideTargetHumiditySensor.title: Hide Dehumidifier Target Humidity Sensor
hideTargetHumiditySensor.description: Enable this option to hide the separate target humidity sensor for dehumidifiers. The target humidity will still be accessible through the main dehumidifier service.

showDisplayLight.title: Show Dehumidifier Display Control
showDisplayLight.description: Show a HomeKit light tile to toggle the dehumidifier display on/off.

showPanelSoundSwitch.title: Show Dehumidifier Beep Switch
showPanelSoundSwitch.description: Show a switch to enable/disable the device beeps (if supported by the model).
